name: Kitchen hygiene inspection (FSSAI Schedule 4)
source: docs/FSSAI 2026 KITCHEN SAFETY CHECKLIST.docx, sections 1 to 10
note: The checks are the founder's wording. The document does not mark any check as critical; the ones marked here were chosen by matching FSSAI's asterisk (*) hygiene rating questions (see "basis") and need the founder's review.

checks.text: FSSAI License/Registration is valid and displayed.
Food Safety Display Board (FSDB) is displayed and readable.
Food Safety Management System (FSMS) procedures are implemented.
Good Hygiene Practices (GHP) and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) are followed.
Food Safety Supervisor is appointed where applicable.
Food handlers have received appropriate food-safety training.
Training and food-safety records are maintained.
checks.basis: Hygiene rating Q51*: documentation and records are available and retained

checks.text: Consumer complaints are recorded and corrective actions are documented.
Kitchen and surrounding areas are clean and hygienic.
Floors are clean, washable, non-absorbent and non-slippery.
Walls and ceilings are clean and maintained.
Doors/windows are clean and prevent pest entry.
Adequate lighting is available.
Adequate ventilation/exhaust is available.
Potable water is available for food preparation and cleaning.
checks.basis: Hygiene rating Q8*: potable water is used

checks.text: Water-testing records are maintained where applicable.
Adequate space is available to prevent cross-contamination.
Drains are clean and functioning properly.
Hands are washed properly before food handling.
checks.basis: Hygiene rating Q46*: personal cleanliness and behaviour, hand washing

checks.text: Hands are washed after toilet use and handling raw food/waste.
checks.basis: Hygiene rating Q46*: personal cleanliness and behaviour, hand washing

checks.text: Clean protective clothing/apron is worn.
Hair is properly covered/restrained.
Fingernails are short and clean.
Jewellery is removed where it could contaminate food.
Cuts/wounds are covered with suitable waterproof dressings.
Food handlers do not smoke, spit or engage in unhygienic practices.
Sick employees are prevented from handling food where appropriate.
Applicable health/medical records are maintained.
Ingredients are purchased from approved/reliable suppliers.
Incoming food is inspected for quality and contamination.
Packaged food has intact packaging.
Expiry/use-by dates are checked.
Raw and ready-to-eat foods are segregated.
Food is stored off the floor.
FIFO/FEFO stock rotation is followed.
Refrigerated foods are maintained at appropriate temperatures.
checks.basis: Hygiene rating Q27*: cold food held at 5°C or below

checks.text: Frozen foods are maintained under appropriate temperature control.
checks.basis: Hygiene rating Q27*: frozen food held at -18°C or below

checks.text: Refrigerators/freezers are clean.
Temperature records are maintained.
Chemicals are stored separately from food.
Food containers are clean, covered and appropriately labelled.
Raw and ready-to-eat food preparation is adequately segregated.
Appropriate chopping boards/utensils are used.
Fruits and vegetables are appropriately washed.
Food is thoroughly cooked using an appropriate process.
checks.basis: Hygiene rating Q24*: food cooked to the required core temperature

checks.text: Cooking/reheating temperatures are monitored where required.
checks.basis: Hygiene rating Q28*: reheating reaches 75°C at the core

checks.text: Cooked food is protected from contamination.
Ready-to-eat food is handled hygienically.
Clean utensils are used for serving.
Food is not unnecessarily handled with bare hands.
Cooked/perishable food is not left at unsafe temperatures for extended periods.
checks.basis: Hygiene rating Q25* and Q27*: cooling and holding temperatures

checks.text: Raw meat, poultry, fish and eggs are separated from ready-to-eat food.
Separate utensils/equipment are used or properly sanitised between uses.
Raw-food preparation surfaces are cleaned before ready-to-eat food preparation.
Cleaning cloths are clean and changed regularly.
Food handlers avoid contaminating food-contact surfaces.
Stored food is covered and protected.
Raw food is stored to prevent leakage onto other foods.
Food-contact surfaces are cleaned and sanitised regularly.
Utensils and cookware are cleaned after use.
Worktops and preparation areas are clean.
Floors, walls and sinks are cleaned.
Cleaning chemicals are correctly labelled.
Cleaning chemicals are stored away from food.
Cleaning equipment is kept clean and stored hygienically.
Hand-washing facilities are clean and functional.
Toilets are maintained in hygienic condition.
Cleaning/sanitation records are maintained where required.
No visible signs of insects, rodents or other pests.
checks.basis: Hygiene rating Q41*: no signs of pest activity or infestation

checks.text: No pest droppings, eggs or larvae are observed.
checks.basis: Hygiene rating Q41*: no signs of pest activity or infestation

checks.text: Doors/windows/openings are adequately protected.
Drains and other entry points are protected.
Waste does not accumulate in food areas.
Pest-control programme is implemented where applicable.
Pest-control chemicals cannot contaminate food.
Pest-control records and corrective actions are maintained.
Food waste is removed regularly.
Waste bins are suitable and clean.
Waste bins do not overflow.
Bins are covered where required.
Waste is kept away from food preparation areas.
Drains are free from blockage.
Grease traps are maintained where applicable.
Waste storage area is clean and hygienic.
Equipment is clean and in good working condition.
Food-contact equipment is made from suitable food-safe material.
Damaged/corroded equipment is repaired or replaced.
Thermometers are functional.
Monitoring equipment is calibrated where necessary.
Utensils are cleaned and sanitised.
Clean utensils are stored hygienically.
Refrigeration equipment is functioning correctly.
